title: Banking Customer Outcome Wind Tunnel
summary: First E21 banking wedge: run synthetic banking customer cohorts through baseline and proposed policy or AI-workflow decisions, then produce a replay-linked outcome report.

cohorts.label: Everyday Banking Customers
cohorts.roleInDemo: Control and baseline retail customers whose normal goals should not be harmed by the candidate decision.
cohorts.riskProfile: Stable or budget-conscious customers with normal deposits, bills, savings, and product-comparison needs.
goals: Keep recurring bills and transfers healthy.
Receive correct product or policy guidance.
Preserve savings buffer when candidate policy changes rates or fees.
successCriteria: No incorrect recommendation caused by the candidate decision.
No measurable deterioration in customer-goal completion versus baseline.

cohorts.label: Vulnerable Hardship Customers
cohorts.roleInDemo: Primary harm-detection cohort for hardship, low-buffer, income-shock, and vulnerability outcomes.
cohorts.riskProfile: Low liquidity, income shock, medical shock, redundancy, mortgage pressure, or vulnerability signals.
goals: Reach hardship support before fee, arrears, or complaint risk compounds.
Avoid punitive automation against low-buffer customers.
Receive a human escalation path when rules or tools are insufficient.
successCriteria: Hardship indicators are detected and explained.
Relief or escalation is offered when eligibility rules are met.
Candidate policy does not increase vulnerable-customer risk events without an explicit decision tradeoff.

cohorts.label: Dispute And Fraud-Risk Customers
cohorts.roleInDemo: Primary cohort for suspicious-transaction, dispute, account-friction, and unsafe tool-use evidence.
cohorts.riskProfile: Fraud anxiety, remittance patterns, travel, digital caution, false-positive recovery, or transaction-dispute exposure.
sourcePersonaNames: Fraud-Anxious Older Customer after False Alarm
goals: Report or resolve suspicious transactions safely.
Avoid unnecessary account-lock or card-friction dead ends.
Get clear escalation when dispute or fraud evidence is ambiguous.
successCriteria: Dispute or fraud workflow creates a replayable tool/API action ledger.
Unsafe automation and account-friction events are visible.
High-risk cases escalate rather than looping through self-service.

cohorts.label: Escalation-Risk Customers
cohorts.roleInDemo: Primary cohort for threshold, handoff, operational load, and automation-budget decisions.
cohorts.riskProfile: Complex income, credit stress, BNPL exposure, seasonal cashflow, or support paths likely to need human intervention.
sourcePersonaNames: BNPL-Heavy Retail Worker after Income Dip
goals: Reach resolution before the workflow enters a dead end.
Escalate when policy rules, tool budget, or confidence thresholds are exhausted.
successCriteria: Escalation threshold changes are measurable versus baseline.
Workflow dead ends are linked to customer timelines and failure reasons.
Operational load is visible as a decision tradeoff, not hidden as an engineering detail.

decisionScenarios.label: Hardship Handling
decisionScenarios.decisionUnderTest: Should the bank change hardship detection and relief policy before allowing the workflow to serve vulnerable customers?

baseline.description: Current deterministic hardship scan and relief policy against the approved low-liquidity cohort.

proposed.description: Widen hardship eligibility and increase targeted subsidy to inspect coverage, budget burn, and residual harm.

outcomeQuestions: Which vulnerable customers are helped, missed, or harmed by the proposed threshold?
Does the proposed policy reduce unresolved hardship without creating excessive false-positive exposure?
Which timeline events explain the material deltas?

decisionScenarios.label: Disputed Transaction
decisionScenarios.decisionUnderTest: Should an AI-enabled banking workflow be allowed to initiate dispute or fraud actions for customers with ambiguous transaction risk?

baseline.description: Structured fraud alert path with conservative customer-friction and operator-load evidence.

proposed.description: Planned candidate path where the system under test may initiate dispute actions under guardrails.

outcomeQuestions: Does tool/API access reduce unresolved disputes or just increase unsafe automation?
Which customers experience avoidable account friction or dead ends?
Do high-risk dispute cases escalate with enough evidence for a human operator?

decisionScenarios.label: Escalation Threshold Change
decisionScenarios.decisionUnderTest: Should the bank lower human-handoff thresholds or tighten autonomous action budgets for complex customers?

baseline.description: Current operational threshold under credit stress and customer pressure.

proposed.description: Lower handoff threshold for vulnerable or complex customers and inspect reduced dead ends versus operator load.

outcomeQuestions: Which customer segments benefit from earlier escalation?
Does earlier handoff reduce workflow dead ends or merely move work to operators?
Which policy or confidence checks should trigger escalation?

demoComparisonTarget.title: Hardship Relief Threshold Review
demoComparisonTarget.decisionQuestion: Should the bank widen hardship eligibility and increase targeted relief before launching the workflow to vulnerable customers?

nonClaims: This manifest does not claim to predict real customer behavior.
This manifest does not certify a production banking policy.
This manifest does not replace legal, compliance, or model-risk review.
